tess-mgr: Hi @nidhi-peopleops 3: we have an ops coverage problem for the year-end blackout (Dec 22-28). Our team needs at least 2 folks available each day but several engineers planned floating holidays. Can People Ops temporarily reassign unused floating holidays as 'coverage credits' so people can take time without it touching PTO banks?

nidhi-peopleops: Short answer: potentially. Floating holidays are person-assigned and not pooled by default, but we do an exception flow for team coverage in critical windows. Requirements: manager sign-off, employee opt-in for reallocation, and payroll/locale check. Credits are typically non-accrual and don't affect carryover if applied as shutdown-style credits.

ben-teamlead: Quick Q: does "non-accrual" mean these credits won't count toward the 10-day carryover cap for next year? Our EMEA folks are worried about hitting caps.

nidhi-peopleops: Correct 3 those coverage credits are recorded as "team coverage (non-accrual)" and do not count against carryover caps. We tag them on the employee record so carryover calc ignores them. If anyone prefers a floating day instead (that can carry over) they can opt out.

oliver-eng: Process and timeline? We need this resolved before scheduling freezes on Dec 8.

nidhi-peopleops: Process: 
1) Manager (you) submits People Portal -> Leave Exceptions -> "Team Coverage Credits" with CSV: name, employee id, desired credits (ints), and opt-in deadline.
2) People Ops generates ticket EX-2028-5100 and notifies employees to opt-in.
3) Employees must respond by the opt-in deadline (we recommend 48 hours).
4) Manager approves final allocation in portal.
5) Scheduling maps shifts and People Ops applies credits to payroll records (no cash impact if credits used as time off).

Example CSV snippet you can paste into the portal:
```
name,employee_id,requested_coverage_credits
Aisha Khan,EMP-1023,2
Diego Ruiz,EMP-1098,1
Sree Patel,EMP-1122,1
```

peopleops-bot: New leave exception created: EX-2028-5100 (status: awaiting employee opt-ins)

scheduling-bot: Reminder: scheduling freeze is Dec 8. If opt-ins aren't complete by Dec 7 scheduling can't guarantee coverage mapping.

payroll-bot: Note: if credits require cash reconciliation (rare), payroll cutoff is Dec 15 for year-end processing. Coverage credit application as non-accrual time off has no cash impact.

tess-mgr: Submitted the portal CSV and set opt-in deadline Dec 5. EX-2028-5100 should be visible.

peopleops-bot: EX-2028-5100 updated: opt-in notifications sent to 12 employees.

Aisha Khan (reply to portal notification): Opt-in yes for 2 credits. Prefer credits be non-accrual (don't touch my floating bank).

Diego Ruiz (reply): Opt-in for 1 credit. If pulled, please ensure it's not used against carryover.

Sree Patel (reply): I can't opt-in 3 need the floating days for a personal event. Please skip me.

nidhi-peopleops: Noted. We'll allocate the 4 requested credits: Aisha 2, Diego 1, and reassign Sree's 1 credit back to the team pool. Tess, confirm if you want us to auto-apply the remaining credit to the next person on the CSV (or hold).

tess-mgr: Hold please 3 I'll confirm a replacement. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

peopleops-bot: EX-2028-5100 status: pending manager final allocation (hold requested).

scheduling-bot: Scheduling: once manager finalizes allocation we'll map shifts and post provisional coverage blocks.

nidhi-peopleops: Final note: if you plan to run this for multiple teams, batch requests to avoid hitting multiple payroll cutoffs. We can bundle all team coverage credits in one processing run. Reach out if you want People Ops to own the opt-in followups.

tess-mgr: Appreciate it. I'll finalize allocation by EOD tomorrow. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
